title: Client request record (PROPOSED)
description: PROPOSED by DEL-01-01/HOSTING-BOUNDARY-v0.8 §5, §5.1-§5.2 (R12-1, R12-2). One record per request the App sends, or refuses to send, to the supplier through the generic request path. Element names are Chirality's own; the supplier's method, identities, parameters and error content are carried as data. Placement is not chosen (R12-2); persistence is DEL-01-02's. CC-H proposed candidate (2026-10-04); independent review pending. CC-H-ATTACHMENT-CORRELATION successor adds pointer-only prewrite submission association and prepared observation; joined consumer review required.

generation.description: CC-H: full H5 identity. appSession is unique across App launches; home is stable App-owned home identity, not a credential or OS path.

requestIdentity.description: Native RPC identity as sent, or reserved before pipewrite for an associated submission; reservation is not dispatch/acceptance. Null only on refusal before allocation.

submissionAssociation.description: CC-H-ATTACHMENT-CORRELATION: immutable App pointer-only association persisted before actual scoped pipewrite. Complete full-generation/RPC/method key is in the containing record; no native payload or turn ID invented. Ordered supplyRefs resolve owning immutable NIR records with turnRef equal to submissionRef; uniqueness is checked at the preparation boundary. Prepared-only evidence does not prove dispatch never occurred after a crash.

expectedTurnId.description: Only for turn/steer: the actual observed target/precondition submitted, not a guessed native turn.

name.description: The named App rule, or the receiving deliverable (e.g. DEL-03-03).

actorRef.description: For person-directed: the actor reference supplied by the owning interface.

refusalReason.description: Why the boundary did not send it; run-holding is governance phase only (HP-4).

waitingEnded.description: True when the caller's wait limit ended its waiting; the outcome is unaffected (H10).

element.description: Which supplier guidance element was carried (supplier name, as data).
